title: Rebind the changed BIT route to an exact ternary matcher and router control
body:
The #7884 zero-net word preserves grade counts while moving native occurrences. The regenerated 36-call ordered table changes digest, and the exact changed rank-three matcher has 45 factors. One factor vanishes modulo 3 but moves all 3,888 tested high records unless its carry is streamed. The full-ring control verifies returned records and owner separation.

Pins #7868 3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c, #7863 b3e4412fe01f07dc58305616fabf96345f49a781 and #7884. The offline python3 -IB verify.py replay and relocated manifest passed with incorrect chronology/source and optimized-mode controls. Conditional funding and stock inequalities retain the assumptions in README. Credit Ali Romman and retained contributors. OpenAI Codex assisted.

## Open next questions

A physically bound full supplier, stock and precision ledger and an application with positive signed margin remain open.
